description: UK Power Networks Licence Area 66kV Underground Cables is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction Shapefile showing UK Power Networks' 66kV underground cables. Please be aware that we have not published the dataset as we are currently vectorising LPN. Please keep an eye on our Data Roadmap for further updates on delivery. Refer to our LPN Vectorisation Delivery dataset. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network Infrastructure. The portal shows 2025-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Power Networks Shared Data Licence - Connections (https://ukpowernetworks.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/OpenDataPortalLibrary/IQAoqS-OWZGDS5ASk8EwxCETAa5aj8Kx7RISQB6tlPq5-yk?e=6QOYk3). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
